Equipment Technician
description:
**About The Business**
 Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL) is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components.
   

  

 Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) is building India’s first AI\-enabled state\-of\-the\-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high\-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence. Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata group.
   

  

 The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission 'To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust.’
   

  

**Role \& Responsibilities**
* Machines Handled SPI,Fuji, GKG Printer, Reflow, and AOI.
* SMT Machine maintenance / Troubleshooting / Calibration.
* Skill knowledge in line Installation, Alignment and bring up activities.
* Skill in FUJI Mounter programming / Cycle time reduction.
* Skill in Breakdown analysis / Troubleshooting \& Repair.
* Machine Tossing control and spare part management.
* New product development, CPK, GRR, Machine Installation.
* Ensure all stations are producing product that meets the company s quality standards.
* Evaluate and modify the manufacturing material workflow for increased throughput and productivity if required.
* With the line Engineers/Managers and supervisors, develop and maintain work schedules that support 100% on\-time delivery to main lines.
* Work with the line managers, supervisors and direct employees on a daily basis to improve quality levels (Goal: Zero Defect product).
* Maintain a safe and clean work environment by educating and directing personnel.
* Ensure equipment and tools are in good working condition and available for use when required.


**Education**
* Diploma in related field


**Experience**
* Minimum 5 Years of experience in SMT.

title: Transport Executive
description:
**About the Company:** 




 Tata Electronics is a prominent global player in the electronics manufacturing industry, with fast\-emerging capabilities in Electronics Manufacturing Services, Semiconductor Assembly and Test, Semiconductor Foundry, and Design Services. Established in 2020 as a greenfield venture of the Tata Group, the company aims to serve global customers through integrated offerings across a trusted electronics and semiconductor value chain.
 
 https://www.tataelectronics.com/
 




  






 Required Qualifications \& Experience
 



1. Experience: 3 – 4 years of hands\-on experience in corporate /manufacturing transport management, fleet operations, or logistics administration.
2. Education: Bachelor’s degree.
3. Industry Knowledge: Strong understanding of local transport regulations, motor vehicle acts, and labour compliance relevant to transport operations.



  





**About the role:** 





 Operations \& Fleet Management
 



1. Oversee end\-to\-end daily transport operations for employee commuting (cab/bus fleets) and customer\-facing transit requirements.
2. Utilize advanced transport management software/tools to optimize route planning, roster scheduling, vehicle tracking, and capacity utilization.
3. Ensure 100% adherence to safety protocols, transport compliance laws, driver licensing, and vehicle fitness standards.
4. Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) for emergency response, vehicle breakdowns, and route diversions.
5. Keep route chart and master updated.
6. Work with CFT to get roasters and plan the transport ops.
7. Maintain 90% \+ occupancy throughout the transport operations.



  






 Vendor Management \& Contract Management
 



1. Transport Vendor and contract performance evaluations (KPIs/SLAs), and contract renewals.
2. Track OTA and OTD.
3. Ensure compliance w.r.t to govt norms, regulation and policies.
4. Maintain strong relationships with external logistics providers, cab aggregators, and fleet vendors.



  






 Financial Control, Billing \& SAP Integration
 



1. Manage the complete billing lifecycle—verifying vendor invoices against logs, trip sheets, and GPS tracking data before submission.
2. Execute purchase requisitions (POs), service entry sheets (SES), and invoice processing within SAP.
3. Analyze monthly transport expenditure against budgets, identifying cost variances and implementing corrective actions.



  






 Audits, MIS \& Compliance
 



1. Maintain comprehensive Management Information System (MIS) reports detailing fleet efficiency, cost\-per\-kilometre, cost per employee, transit times, and vehicle utilization.
2. Conduct regular physical and operational audits of fleet vehicles, driver behaviour, and safety equipment.
3. Monitor driver compliance (background checks, duty hours, alcohol checks) and statutory documentation (insurance, pollution certificates).



  






 Technical \& Functional Skills
 



1. ERP Proficiency: Solid working knowledge of SAP (SAP modules for PR creation, billing verification, and invoicing and SES process)
2. Transport Tools: Direct experience using automated transport management software (TMS), GPS tracking platforms, and route\-optimization tools.
3. Data Analytics: Advanced proficiency in MS Excel for MIS generation, pivot reporting, and cost\-trend analyses.



  






 Key Competencies
 



1. Strong analytical and vendor management skills.
2. Excellent problem\-solving abilities and dynamic crisis management under pressure.
3. High attention to detail in audits, billing, and SLA tracking.
4. Strong communication skills to liaise with internal stakeholders, vendors, and customers.

title: Soft Services Lead
description:
**About the Company** 




 Tata Electronics is a prominent global player in the electronics manufacturing industry, with fast\-emerging capabilities in Electronics Manufacturing Services, Semiconductor Assembly and Test, Semiconductor Foundry, and Design Services. Established in 2020 as a greenfield venture of the Tata Group, the company aims to serve global customers through integrated offerings across a trusted electronics and semiconductor value chain.
 
 https://www.tataelectronics.com/
 




  





**Job Purpose** 




 The Soft Services Lead is responsible for directing and overseeing end\-to\-end soft services operations across dual environments (corporate headquarters and manufacturing plant facilities). This role ensures seamless daily facility management, statutory hygiene compliance, vendor performance, budget control, and high operational standards. Key priorities include overseeing housekeeping, pantry operations, scrap collection \& segregation, feminine hygiene bin management, landscaping, SAP procurement (PR/SES creation), and data\-driven MIS tracking.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities \& Operational Scope** 




  





**1\. Housekeeping \& Hygiene Bin Management** 



* **Daily Housekeeping Operations:** 
 Oversee comprehensive housekeeping activities across office floors, executive zones, plant restrooms, shop floors, and common areas to maintain highest cleanliness standards.
* **Hygiene Bin Management:** 
 Direct the installation, routine servicing, compliance, and sanitary disposal of female hygiene bins across all corporate and plant washrooms. Ensure strictly regulated chemical treatments, specialized disposal bags, and contract compliance with specialized vendor services.
* **Chemicals \& Equipment Expertise:** 
 Maintain thorough technical knowledge of day\-to\-day cleaning chemicals (MSDS compliance, dilution ratios, eco\-friendly agents) and modern mechanized cleaning equipment (scrubber\-driers, high\-pressure jet pumps, vacuum cleaners, carpet extractors).



**2\. Pantry \& Scrap/Waste Operations** 



* **Pantry \& Catering Services:** 
 Manage end\-to\-end pantry operations, refreshment supplies, cafeteria hygiene, executive catering setups, and vending machine replenishment.
* **Scrap Collection \& Segregation:** 
 Supervise systematic scrap collection, segregation (hazardous, non\-hazardous, organic, recyclable), waste storage, and compliant disposal in accordance with company EHS policies and environmental regulations.



**3 Landscaping \& Horticulture** 



* **Grounds \& Indoor Plants:** 
 Oversee basic landscaping, lawn maintenance, potted indoor plant rotation, garden upkeep, and seasonal planting across corporate lawns and plant periphery.



**4\. Vendor, Contract \& SLA Management** 



* **Vendor Governance:** 
 Manage soft service contractors and specialized agency staff. Track daily deployment, attendance, and adherence to standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* **SLA \& KPI Tracking:** 
 Define, monitor, and enforce Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Conduct monthly vendor evaluations and scorecards.
* **Contract Administration:** 
 Assist in contract renewals, drafting Scopes of Work (SOW), rate negotiations, and ensuring compliance with statutory labour laws.



**5\. Financial Control \& SAP Operations** 



* **SAP Procurement:** 
 Hands\-on execution of SAP workflow, including the timely creation of Purchase Requisitions (PR) and Service Entry Sheets (SES) for all soft service expenses.
* **Invoice Verification \& Auditing:** 
 Audit and verify vendor monthly billing, service logs, and attendance sheets prior to sign\-off to ensure zero leakage.
* **Budget Control:** 
 Monitor monthly operational expenditure (OPEX) against allocated operational budgets, identifying cost optimization and saving opportunities.



**6\. Quality Assurance, Audits \& MIS Reporting** 



* **Facility Audits \& CAPA:** 
 Conduct daily/weekly site inspections and hygiene audits. Implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) for identified non\-compliances.
* **Expert Excel \& MIS Reporting:** 
 Leverage expert\-level MS Excel skills (Pivot Tables, Advanced Formulas, Dashboards, Data Trends) to prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports for management review.



  





**Key Skills \& Technical Competencies** 



* **SAP Systems:** 
 Proficiency in SAP (MM/PM modules) for PR creation, SES approval, and vendor purchase tracking.
* **Advanced MS Excel:** 
 Expertise in data analysis, dashboard creation, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, and financial tracking.
* **Hygiene \& Sanitation:** 
 Comprehensive knowledge of industrial cleaning chemicals, infection control, and specialized hygiene bin servicing.
* **Equipment Knowledge:** 
 Hands\-on understanding of operating and maintaining commercial cleaning machinery.
* **Vendor \& Budget Management:** 
 Strong skills in contract negotiation, audit control, SLA tracking, and OPEX management.
* **Communication \& Leadership:** 
 Excellent verbal/written skills to coordinate with corporate leaders, plant managers, and frontline labour.



  





**Qualifications \& Requirements** 



* **Education:** 
 Bachelor's degree in Hotel Management, Facility Management, Business Administration, or related discipline.
* **Work Experience:** 
 4–5 years of progressive experience in Soft Services management, ideally handling combined Corporate Office and Manufacturing Plant environments.
* **Shift \& Location:** 
 Willingness to manage plant\-level shift operations and respond to facility emergencies as required.
